description.en: Plays the chapter-title screen for a given episode ID: fades to black, loads and shows the title background and text images plus a voice-over, fades back in, plays the voice-over while fading the title text in, waits for it to finish, fades to black again, then cleans up the images/sound.
Episode/chapter ID used to build the title image and sound file paths (data/img/ep<chapID>_<LG>.xi, ep<chapID>_<LG> sound event).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.
